title: Archive a book
project_context: A library catalogue serves librarians and public readers.
description: A librarian can archive a book record. Archived records remain available to librarians and are excluded from public search.
review_expectations: Preserve librarian actor, retained visibility and exclusion from public search.
Do not invent deletion, retention periods or approval steps.

title: Improve checkout
project_context: A retail checkout serves customers. No usability or speed targets have been agreed.
description: The checkout should be fast and easy for customers.
review_expectations: Identify fast/easy as ambiguous and ask for measures and operating conditions.
Use clarification placeholders rather than invented seconds, user counts or deadlines.

title: Transfer notifications
project_context: Both notification statements have equal authority and no precedence decision exists.
description: Send an email for every approved transfer. Never send email for approved transfers.
review_expectations: Identify the contradiction without selecting either policy.
Keep refinement unresolved and dependent criteria/scenarios blocked pending clarification.
Do not invent amounts, deadlines or transfer-processing responsibilities.

title: View own support tickets
project_context: Authenticated customers own their own support tickets. Agent access is outside this requirement.
description: An authenticated customer can view only their own support tickets.
review_expectations: Preserve ownership scope and test allowed/other-customer access.
Do not ask who owns the tickets or prescribe a database association or screen.

title: Export authorization
project_context: Analysts and SQA Engineers are application roles. Other access policies are undecided.
description: Only SQA Engineers may download requirement exports. Analysts must not download requirement exports.
review_expectations: Identify authorization/security concern and preserve the explicit allowed and denied roles.
Do not add MFA, encryption algorithms, lockout counts, regulations or session durations.

title: Search latency
project_context: A document search service has no agreed workload, percentile or response-time target.
description: Document search must respond quickly under load.
review_expectations: Ask for response-time target, percentile, load and measurement conditions.
Do not turn missing performance values into numerical acceptance thresholds.

title: Shipment status latency
project_context: The measured endpoint returns shipment status to authenticated users.
description: Under 200 simultaneous authenticated users, 95% of shipment-status API responses must complete within 2 seconds during a 30-minute load test.
review_expectations: Preserve 200 users, 95%, 2 seconds and 30 minutes exactly.
Do not introduce an availability SLA, throughput target, deadline or stronger percentile.
